read: The recipe does transfer to VGGT-Omega -- near-rim AbsRel improves on all 6 sequences and both splits (-19.3% to -40.6%), so the backbone-agnostic claim holds. But it transfers with a smaller effect size than DA3-Small and with more near-center collateral damage on the halves split specifically (up to +49.8% vs DA3-Small's <+6%) -- VGGT-Omega's final-block tokens carry less of whatever DA3-Small's carry that lets the head correct the rim without touching the center.
